title: Parasitic Horizons
description: a modpack designed to make Scape and run: Parasites actually bloody playable
body:
## Parasitic Horizons

**This modpack is currently in development, any bugs and broken progression will be fixed.**

This modpack is designed to make it so Scape & Run Parasites is actually playable instead of the lame end-game that the mod currently has that makes it pretty-much impossible to play, we do this by adding mods like HBM Nuclear Tech for missiles, env tech & Deep Mob Evolution for when your in the endgame and can't go outside, and configs for SRP to make the parasites. not as overpowered, but still a threat.

Any issues found, please report them to the [Issue tracker](https://github.com/StynaST/parasitic-horizons/issues).

Features:
* Tech mods to combat the endgame of SRP
* A playable, **FAIR** config for SRP.
* HBM Nuclear Tech Mod
* No Assimilated Enderman :D




You can view our Mod List [*Here*](https://github.com/StynaST/Parasitic-Horizons/tree/dev/mods)
